note: Key names only, never values. Mirrors what the deploy adapters check: scripts/release/atomic-deploy-aphrody-stack.sh (Aphrody stack env files in /etc/aphrody) and scripts/release/atomic-deploy-shenron.sh (required keys of shenron-site/shenron-bot across their unit env files). provision-aphrody-stack-env.sh --fresh-host writes the Aphrody keys; `aphrody-infra secrets check --service ID --env-file FILE` checks one file.
